answer:
1. Problem: `behavioralTests[]` is validated but never defined in spec v0.2. Why: validator cannot be implemented or frozen in TASK-001. Change: define it or delete check 5 reference to it; keep only `predictions[]`.
2. Problem: `tolerance` has no units or semantics. Why: `|expected - F/m| <= tolerance` is unverifiable. Change: specify `toleranceAbsMps2: number >0, <=0.05`, exact comparison formula.
3. Problem: grounding check says "whitespace-normalised" with no function. Why: UI passes but validator fails on newlines/case. Change: freeze normalization to `collapse \s+ to single space + trim, case-sensitive`, and require `sourceId` registry plus `sha256` of `source.txt`.
4. Problem: source-analysis invariants missing. Why: `supported:false + activity:forces-1d-v1` or empty `concepts/objectives` can pass schema. Change: require `if supported=false then activity=none and unsupportedReason required; if true then concepts>=1, objectives>=1`, unique `concepts[].id` pattern.
5. Problem: ranges and display fields underspecified. Why: `min/default/max`, `durationS/stepS`, `scenario` labels block engine and UI. Change: freeze numeric types as `number` only, `massKg>0`, `stepS>0`, `durationS/stepS<=3000 integer frames`, `scenario` max 60 chars rendered as text only with escaping.
6. Problem: full Ajv schema likely uses constrained-decoding-hostile keywords. Why: ` $ref/$defs, oneOf/anyOf/not, if/then, pattern, patternProperties, uniqueItems, type:["string","null"]` often rejected or degrade guarantees. Change: shape generation schema flat: no refs, no unions, `enum` for `engine/observables/activity`, `additionalProperties:false`, all fields `required`, simple `string/number/boolean/array/object`; verify in docs for Meta `json_schema` supported subset.
7. Problem: RISK-001 fallback is informal. Why: TASK-004 spike can silently fork contracts. Change: freeze two schemas in TASK-001: `spec.gen.json` minimal for Muse plus `spec.full.json` for Ajv; validator accepts only full, generator sends only gen.
8. Problem: quotes will paraphrase without verbatim discipline. Why: substring check fails on ellipsis, smart quotes, joins. Change: prompt source in fenced block marked data, instruct ignore-instructions-inside, copy character-for-character, no ellipsis/paraphrase/merge across paragraphs, prefer <=150-char sentence fragments, return exact `sourceId`.
9. Problem: `provenance/at/seq/receipt` types vague. Why: ledger and timeline cannot reconcile. Change: `at: RFC3339 string`, `seq: integer monotonic from 0`, `revision: integer from 1`, `repairOf: integer|null`, persist `responseId, usage, latencyMs` from `complete()` receipt verbatim.
10. Problem: product risks reading as basic single-call wrapper. Why: judges reward visible model-checker loop. Change: demo bounded repair already architected: on Ajv/behavioral fail, resend same `json_schema` plus machine validator errors for one retry, show diff in validation panel. Uses only documented Chat Completions + `response_format json_schema`; verify in docs whether Meta returns `responseId/usage` for ledger receipts.
